title: Constructibility of higher derived coefficient reductions
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and A a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], of independent coefficient universe. Let J be an ideal and N an object of the pro-etale constant-A derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the actual derived reductions N_n=N tensor^L_A A/J^(n+1) of [lem-sfb-adic-finite-reduction-data]. If N_0 is bounded with affine-locally constructible cohomology [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], then every cohomology sheaf of every N_n is affine-locally constructible over A/J^(n+1) [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]. The conclusion asserts no lower cohomological bound, no Tor interval and no etale origin.

source.place: Tag 09BR, lemma-compare-truncations-constructible, specialized to a bounded residue reduction and retaining only constructibility of cohomology; exponent shifted by one.

proof.text: At n=0, take the all-cohomology constructibility component of the bounded residue hypothesis.

For the successor step work over B=A/J^(n+2). Use the actual graded kernel and its derived tensor layer, and the distinguished coefficient-filtration triangle with middle term N_(n+1) and last term the restriction of N_n.

The graded layer has constructible cohomology by residue balancing, the common finite stratification and locally constant tensor theorem. The restricted lower reduction has constructible cohomology by the induction hypothesis and surjective coefficient restriction.

For arbitrary Noetherian coefficients on the coefficient-sized site, prove the weak Serre property from finite local models. Refine two global stratifications by their actual fibre products. Exact stratum inverse image and constant-scalar equivalence identify kernels, cokernels and short exact sequences with their locally constant counterparts. Transport the finite-type local weak Serre closure through the constant-ring equivalence. Apply the five-term long exact cohomology argument to the filtration triangle. This gives the middle reduction in every degree and completes induction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09BR coefficient-filtration induction; Tag 09B5 weak Serre step implemented directly using finite constant local models on the coefficient-sized site. K1 writes the complete weak Serre and induction glue; three named interface obligations remain.

theorem adicFiniteReduction_constructible_cohomology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (N : adicFiniteAmbient.{u, v} X A)
    (hres : ProEtale.coefficientBoundedConstructibleProEtale.{u, v} X
      (adicFiniteCoeff J 0) (adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N 0)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsCoefficientAffineLocallyConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf.{u, v} X
        (adicFiniteCoeff J n)
        ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj (adicFiniteReduction.{u, v} X J N n))
